description:
• Brand introduction: CMC Motorsports
• Product description: The team at CMC Motorsports lives and breathes Formula 1 Racing and always strives to bring the thrill of the Grand Prix directly to you. Discover your favorite F1 driver fan gear or explore the F1 racing collections and Motorsports collections easily and with confidence. CMC Motorsports provides authentic apparel, and as an officially licensed F1 online retailer, you can expect exceptional quality every time you shop. With fast, free shipping on select orders, it’s easier than ever to find the best in F1 fan apparel, accessories, collectibles, and gifts.
• USP (Unique Selling Point): Full range of licensed F1 apparel and accesories.  Licensed general motorsport and IndyCar apparel and accesories.
• Payment terms: Monthly via PayPal
payout_period: Payouts for orders outside of our 60 day return policy are paid in the first week of every month via PayPal.
term_and_condition:
Welcome to CMC Motorsports®! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.



The following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use products or services from the merchant.



By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and is bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety, you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.



1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.

2. Affiliate Links, Coupons, and Traffic Restrictions

  • Link Tracking: Affiliate links are automatically generated, but you can also generate a link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later clicks on yours, yours is the one that counts.

  • Coupons: Affiliates may be assigned a coupon code. If a customer clicks an affiliate link and uses a coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you are not assigned a branded coupon, you are not allowed to promote one.

  • Promotion Channels: Affiliates may advertise the merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram, etc., or offline via magazines and newspapers.

  • Prohibited Traffic: The use of Google Ads (including Search, Display, and Shopping) to drive traffic to affiliate links is strictly prohibited. Any affiliate found to be running Google Ads campaigns directing to our site will have their commissions voided and their account terminated immediately.

3. Commissions and Payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, and you will receive a commission calculated based on our Commission structure. The commission amount is dependent on order value and does not include extra fees (tax, shipping, etc.).

  • Payment Details: You must specify payment details in Settings to receive commissions.

  • Schedule: The payment schedule is notified on the Affiliate Guide page.

  • Fair Use: All referral orders are subject to review. Transactions resulting in chargebacks or refunds will not be paid out.

  • Holding Period: Payments are delayed 60 days to allow for the return period to expire.

4. Marketing Tools

We may share promotional media such as banners, logos, or specific collection assets through the Marketing Tool tab. You can download this media or use the HTML embed code to share on your authorized affiliate channels.

5. Network

If the Network tab is activated, affiliates can invite others to become their downline. If a downline affiliate generates an order, the upline affiliate will receive a network commission based on merchant settings. To invite others, share your network link; any affiliate who signs up via that link becomes your downline.

6. Cookies

We use cookies to track referrals. Customers must have cookies enabled for us to track the sale.

  • If a customer clears or disables cookies, we cannot track the activity or pay commissions.

  • The Cookie Duration is specified on the registration form. Tracking begins the moment a customer clicks your link or uses your coupon. Within this window, any subsequent orders made by that customer will result in a commission without needing another click.

7. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the program, they can do so by contacting: rfalco@cmcmotorsports.com.
